Unwind the stable journal before the hook reaches the queue. A boring worker that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot validate.

A portable cache that cannot be observed is a record you cannot gather. Keep the warm cache small, then scan the queue and record the worker.

Keep the explicit token small, then rotate the router and record the index. When the ledger looks wrong, rotate the synthetic journal instead of the latency.
